orchestrator.gauss.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL of the internal Gauss API. All planning traffic goes here and nowhere else.

orchestrator.gauss.model.description: Model identifier used for all planning calls.

orchestrator.adapters.claude.path.description: Path to the Claude Code CLI binary.

orchestrator.adapters.codex.path.description: Path to the Codex CLI binary.

orchestrator.adapters.gemini.path.description: Path to the Gemini CLI binary.

orchestrator.adapters.claude.bare.markdownDescription:
Whether to run `claude` with `--bare` (skips CLAUDE.md/hooks/MCP to save tokens).

`--bare` only works with an **API key** (`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`), a gateway token, or Bedrock/Vertex — it cannot use a plain **Claude Pro/Max subscription login**.

- `auto` (default): on when an API-key-style credential is present, off otherwise — so your Pro subscription works out of the box.
- `on`: always use `--bare` (requires an API key).
- `off`: never use it (needed for subscription auth; costs a little more per call).

orchestrator.adapters.env.markdownDescription:
Extra environment variables for spawned CLIs, merged over the extension host's own environment.

The CLIs authenticate themselves — this extension never holds an Anthropic, OpenAI or Google key. But a VS Code window launched from Finder or the Dock does **not** inherit your shell profile, so a key exported in `.zshrc` will be missing and the CLI fails with an auth error that looks like an extension bug.

Example: `{ "ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL": "https://llm-gateway.internal", "CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK": "1" }`.

Prefer pointing at a gateway or a credential helper over pasting a raw key here — `settings.json` is usually a tracked file.

orchestrator.pricing.markdownDescription: Per-model price overrides in USD per million tokens, e.g. `{ "claude-opus-4-8": { "input": 5, "output": 25 } }`. Merged over the built-in table. Prices change; keep this current.

orchestrator.baseline.sampleRate.description: Fraction of tasks that also run a true naive baseline to calibrate the savings estimator. Costs real tokens.

orchestrator.baseline.frontierModel.description: Model the modeled baseline assumes a developer would otherwise have used.

orchestrator.policy.codenames.markdownDescription: Internal project codenames. Any file mentioning one is classified `confidential` before Gauss is even asked. Cheap and highly effective — keep this list current.

orchestrator.policy.allowRestrictedOverr.markdownDescription: Allow a reviewer to approve a `restricted` file for external use. Off by default: the restricted tier exists precisely so that bootloader, TEE and key material are not a per-file judgement call. Turn on only with security owner sign-off.

orchestrator.scan.maxFileBytes.markdownDescription: Largest single file (in bytes) the tool will read. Files above this are skipped and reported. Default 2 MB. Raise it if you work with large generated or data files — but note a very large file is many tokens, so it will be skeletonized or truncated when sent to a model.

orchestrator.scan.digestTokens.markdownDescription: Token budget for the sample of each file sent to Gauss. Secret detection runs on full content regardless; this only bounds the semantic judgement. Raise it to close the gap where a lone sensitive paragraph sits mid-file.

orchestrator.scan.batchSize.description: Files classified per Gauss call. Larger batches amortize prompt overhead.

orchestrator.context.budgetTokens.description: Ceiling on selected context per plan.

orchestrator.budget.maxRunUsd.markdownDescription: Hard spend ceiling for a single run, in USD, including Gauss planning. Once real provider-reported spend crosses it, no further subtask is dispatched. `0` means no cap. This is the safety net under plan approval: approval gates the *forecast*, this stops a run that blows past it.
